title: King Crimson Exeggutor (JCraft: EOE)
description: Replaces King Crimson's model with a long neck similar to Exeggutor's (JOJO, JJBA)
body:
Replaces King Crimson's model with a long neck similar to Exeggutor's (JOJO, JJBA)

Got this idea from a joke in the JCraft: EOE server

This will also work with any King Crimson reskins such as [my Vinegar Crimson reskin](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vinegar-king-crimson-(jcraft-eoe))

Changes the appearence of your JoJo stand

Type "Subsetg4ming" in your search bar to find everything by me!
